newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy March truck deliveries fall 14.09 percent.
newsitem.headline: Italy March truck deliveries fall 14.09 percent.

text.p: Italian commercial vehicle deliveries in March slipped 14.09 percent to 12,813 vehicles compared to March 1996, said a statement from Italian vehicle makers association Anfia and importing body Unrae on Friday.
On a three month basis, deliveries in January-March 1997 fell 10.47 percent to 35,490 vehicles.
Italian domestic manufacturers saw their March deliveries fall by 10.12 percent to 7,324, giving them a market share of 57.16 percent from 54.64 percent a year ago.

Among the domestic makers, Fiat Auto saw deliveries off 15.44 percent at 5,055, while Fiat heavy truck unit Iveco registered a rise of 4.51 percent to 1,554 vehicles and light van maker Piaggio was up 1.12 percent at 633 units.
Among the importers, Ford showed deliveries off 30.70 percent at 1,447 vehicles, Nissan was down 31.66 percent at 775 vehicles, but Mercedes showed a gain up 18.49 percent to 724.
